name: mycelium
description: I realized I let the agent start coding before I was sure it was working on the right thing, so I built this. Now it doesn't get to write code before there's a reason. The agent asks who this is for. It asks what you're assuming, and what would show you wrong. The rules run as hooks, so the build stays shut until the answers are there. Purpose, strategy, opportunities, then delivery and market feedback. It adds skills and hooks, keeps its own state in a .claude/ folder, and won't edit the files already in your repo unless you ask it to.
